title: Northstar Labs pilot and security review
summary: Northstar wants to start a five-person pilot, but its legal review is blocked until it receives Nouvel's security material. The buyer asked for a response by Monday afternoon.
transcript:
Maya Chen: Thanks for making the time. What would you need to move forward with a pilot?
Carla Ruiz: We want to start with five SDRs. The eight-thousand-pound quarterly budget is approved, although our CFO still needs to sign the final order.
Carla Ruiz: Legal will not begin its review until it has your security questionnaire and data-retention policy. Could you send both by Monday afternoon?
Maya Chen: Yes, I will send the security questionnaire and retention policy by Monday afternoon.
Carla Ruiz: Great. If legal is comfortable, we would like the pilot to begin on 12 October.
Carla Ruiz: One open question is whether prospect call transcripts can be deleted after ninety days. Please address that in the follow-up.
Maya Chen: I will confirm the deletion options in the same email.

title: Harbour Analytics discovery call
summary: Harbour is exploring options and asked for a retail case study before an internal planning meeting next week.
transcript:
Leo Grant: Does the workflow sound relevant to your team?
Nina Shah: Potentially, but we are still exploring options and do not have an approved project yet.
Nina Shah: Could you send the retail case study when you get a chance? We will discuss it at our planning meeting next week.
Leo Grant: Yes, I will send it over.

title: Cedar Partners introductory conversation
summary: Cedar is not evaluating outbound tools this year and requested no proposal.
transcript:
Ava Cole: Would it be useful if I sent a proposal?
Tom Reed: We are not evaluating outbound tools this year. Please do not send a proposal. I will get back in touch if our priorities change.
Ava Cole: Understood, I will leave it with you.
